_comment: Copy this file to build/local_checks.json (that file is git-ignored and must never be published). name_tokens: first names / nicknames / surnames of participants and of any outside people named in the raw notes. phrases: full names. restricted: regular expressions for project-confidential terms. redactions: key -> [original text, replacement]; a discussion in curation/discussions_*.yaml opts in with `redact: [key]`, so the original wording never appears in the published repo.
